values.value: Temple and Sourcery form the execution foundation and authoring platform beneath this ecosystem. I want power, permission and change to have an account people can inspect.
Temple and Sourcery provide an explicit way to describe behaviour and compose its parts. I’m interested in how that can support a world whose choices and changes remain understandable.
I want technology to support care without taking over judgment. Clear permission, understandable behaviour and the possibility of repair matter to the things I choose to build.
The software beneath this work should make authority visible, leave room for refusal and preserve a path to correction. These are engineering commitments I want to bring into the way I serve.
